utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Mr. Registrar, please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is the case number IT-05-88-A, the Prosecutor versus Popovic et al. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: And the appearances, beginning with the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MS. SOLJAN
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour, everybody. On behalf of the Prosecution, my name is Lada Soljan, and my colleagues Virginie Monchy and Janet Stewart.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. Defence.

utterances.speaker: MS. TAPUSKOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honours. I am Mira Tapuskovic, co-counsel for Vujadin Popovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTOJIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. My name is John Ostojic. I am here on behalf of Mr. Ljubisa Beara.

utterances.speaker: MS. NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honours. Jelena Nikolic, attorney-at-law, appearing on behalf of Mr. Nikolic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. And Mr. Miletic.

utterances.speaker: MS. FAUVEAU
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Natacha Fauveau-Ivanovic, together with my co-counsel, Mr. Nenad Petrusic for Radivoje Miletic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. And for Mr. Pandurevic.

utterances.speaker: MR. HAYNES
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour, Peter Haynes and Simon Davis for Vinko Pandurevic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: As you know, this appeal previously had six Defence Appellants, but the appellate proceedings with respect to Milan Gvero were terminated by the Appeals Chamber in a decision on the 7th of March, 2013, following his death. On behalf of the Tribunal, I'd like to extend my sincere condolences to his family. I begin with a summary of recent decisions apart from the termination decision to which I just referred. First, on the 30th of January, 2013, the Appeals Chamber issued a decision granting an urgent motion filed by Mr. Popovic for custodial release on compassionate grounds, and similar to this decision on 7th February 2013, the Appeals Chamber issued a decision on the Prosecution's urgent motion concerning the sufficiency of guarantees received in support of Mr. Popovic's custodial release. On the 20th of February, 2013, the Chamber granted in part Mr. Ratko Mladic's request for access to confidential to material in the Popovic et al. case. On the 7th of March, the Chamber issued a decision terminating appellate proceedings in relation to Mr. Milan Gvero. And finally, on the 15th of April, 2013, the Chamber issued a decision denying two motions filed by Mr. Miletic, his first and second motions pursuant to Rule 115. May I follow-up on the Appeals Chamber's public decision on the motion by Ratko Mladic for access to confidential information dated the 20th of February, 2013. You recall that pursuant to that decision, the Prosecution and the Defence teams were ordered, among other things, to file before the Appeals Chamber and the Registry within 10 working days from the date of that decision lists identifying material related to personal information about the Popovic et al. case, Defence and their family members, as well as lists identifying any material provided under Rule 70 of the Rules. I have to note that the Defence for Mr. Beara has not yet filed these lists. I've been informed by the Registry that the Beara Defence sought to file a notice on this issue in April, but due to an incorrect cover page it could not be filed. I therefore order that the Defence for Mr. Beara file these lists by Friday, the 10th of May, 2013. I now provide a brief summary of the status of the pending motions before the Appeals Chamber in this case. The Chamber is currently seized of, one, two motions filed by Mr. Popovic, his third and fourth motions pursuant to Rule 115, filed on the 15th of August, 2011, and the 19th of September, 2011, respectively. All responses and replies have been received by the Appeals Chamber and the motions remain under consideration by the Chamber. I remind all parties of their obligation to provide translations of all documents and exhibits filed into one of the working languages of the Tribunal. Secondly, a motion filed on the 18th of March, 2013, by Dr. Radovan Karadzic requesting access to exculpatory non-privileged material. The Prosecution filed its response on the 27th of March, 2013, and the motion remains under consideration by the Chamber. Let me touch upon one matter that was raised at the last Status Conference. I refer to the request by counsel for Mr. Nikolic, which was joined by counsel for Mr. Beara, that a minimum of two months' notice be given by the Chamber to the parties before the oral hearing in this case takes place. At that time I told the parties that this request would be taken into consideration. It is still too soon to begin the formal process of scheduling the appeals hearing, but it would certainly be the expectation of the Chamber to issue a Scheduling Order at least two months in advance of the scheduled hearing dates. I turn now to the question of conditions of detention and the state of health, and I will ask each appellant whether he wishes to raise any concerns regarding his health or the conditions of detention. Mr. Popovic, do you have anything to raise?

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT POPOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, as regards the life in the Detention Unit, there are no issues to raise. However, I would like to express my gratitude personally to the Appeals Chamber to have released me following my mother's death, and I believe I have fully justified the reasons for that and that your trust placed in me in releasing me was justified in the same vein. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Popovic. It was the least we could do in the circumstances, and again our apologies on the passing of your mother. Mr. Beara.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT BEARA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Nothing to raise, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Nikolic.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. President, I am of good health and there are no other issues to raise. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Miletic.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT MILETIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. President, there are no particular issues to raise.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter's note: Could Mr. Popovic's microphone be switched off. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Mr. Pandurevic.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT PANDUREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, everything is fine. There is nothing to raise. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. And I now ask whether there are any additional matters to be raised by the Prosecution or the Defence on behalf of the Prosecution?

utterances.speaker: MS. SOLJAN
utterances.text: Your Honour, the Prosecution has no issues to raise at this time.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. SOLJAN
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Any of the Defence teams? It appears that there is no issue to be raised by the Defence teams. And there being no other matters for consideration, the hearing is adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: adjourned at 2.59 p.m.
